iterations.description: Iterations of the solver that produced the rate (0 for an exact grid root).

tolerance.description: Stopping tolerance on the rate step, decimal fraction (1e-18).

uniqueness_verified.description: True when no other rate can solve the equation (see `explain.conventions`).

xirr.description: Annual rate at which XNPV is zero, decimal fraction, with the chosen compounding.

xnpv_at_xirr.description: XNPV at the returned rate (should be about zero).
